metaDescription: Burmese vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Burmese boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Burmese social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Burmese exposure.
Weight range 8-12 lb (3.5-5.5 kg) and grooming needs (Short satin coat.) belong in the same Burmese household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Burmese is also monitored for hypokalemia risk (some lines), ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Burmese appointments.
After the Burmese puppy/kitten series, keep adult FVRCP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Burmese shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or diabetes risk worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Burmese make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Burmese antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Burmese dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium cat.
Reset the Burmese reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Burmese core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Burmese misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Burmese health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Burmese adult health guide for breed predispositions such as diabetes risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
